conflicts.permit: Only information that we collect is user location and phone state to know whether the phone is turned on or not.
conflicts.prohibit: We don’t collect any personal information regarding our users.
conflicts.situation: When a user uses the apps and their location or phone state data (which constitutes user information) is collected.
conflicts.reason: The policy explicitly states it collects user location and phone state, while also claiming it does not collect any personal information, without clarifying definitions or exceptions.
